## History

Roger Tulk was involved in a paint order mix-up alongside [Joshua Tulk](../character/joshua-tulk.md) that resulted in the Improvement Society's hall being painted bright blue instead of green. Despite the catastrophic outcome of the painting project, the local community rallied behind the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and placed the blame for the mistake on the [Tulks](../codex/factions.md#tulks).

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_
